scenes.title: Where Did Two Trillion Vanish?
scenes.purpose: Establish the sudden collapse of China's epic equity bubble from 5,178 down to 3,000.
scenes.visual: A vibrant Catmull-Rom spline chart scales up to 5,178 before plunging vertically with dynamic coordinate ticks.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, hero spline stage at top 280px-720px, metric takeaway at bottom 1040px

scenes.title: The Borrowed Money Trap
scenes.purpose: Reveal how 5:1 margin leverage mathematically turns a minor pullback into automated liquidation.
scenes.visual: A mechanical radial liquidation gauge drains from 100% to 0% alongside staggered margin violation cards.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, gauge and alert cards in middle stage, margin call badge at bottom

scenes.title: The Everyday Retail Panic
scenes.purpose: Illustrate retail market dominance turning into a liquidity freeze and sell stampede.
scenes.visual: Dual-guide particle stream representing 90 million retail accounts choking order books into a freeze.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, retail volume meter and particle stream in center stage, order halt card at bottom

scenes.title: Why Bailouts Couldn't Fix It
scenes.purpose: Explain the failure of the $200B state rescue fund and land the monumental -$2.4T loss takeaway.
scenes.visual: State bailout stamp shatters with an animated strikethrough, resolving into a monumental -$2.4 Trillion stat.

layout.portrait: Header at top 90px, shattered intervention card at top 320px, monumental -2.4T takeaway at bottom
